scripts.deploy: pnpm deploy:assets && pnpm deploy:static && pnpm deploy:index && pnpm deploy:invalidate
scripts.deploy:assets: aws s3 sync dist/assets/ s3://myloveydove.com/assets/ --cache-control 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable'
scripts.deploy:static: aws s3 sync dist/ s3://myloveydove.com/ --exclude 'assets/*' --exclude index.html --cache-control 'public, max-age=86400'
scripts.deploy:index: aws s3 cp dist/index.html s3://myloveydove.com/index.html --cache-control no-cache
